label: play
js: (() => { game.hold(true); game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); game.put(0, 1, -5.6); game.cat(1, -0.9); game.cat(2, 5.5); w.cfg = Object.assign({}, w.cfg, { cat: 0 }); game.putShaft(0, 1, 2.2, 1); game.put(0,1,-5.2); game.step(0.6); return 'ok'; })()

label: door open
js: (() => { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code:'Space'})); game.step(0.5); return JSON.stringify(game.state().cats); })()
